New grouping dimension above session + CLI + corpus filtering. Depends on TB-26 (session-grain cache sums).

data.to: Per-run cache-token grouping (S40): --run-manifest <run.json> supplies a run's branch set; cache read+creation are attributed PER ENTRY by that entry's gitBranch, normalized per ticket. Entry-grain, not session-grain: sessions straddle branches (29/158) and delegators do not always run in worktrees, so no clean session->run partition exists. PREMISE CORRECTION: the original description named agents.md as the manifest input; it discards its Branch column on run completion and cannot serve. Spec: S40. Depends on TB-26.
